title: Brent
tagline: An agent-powered crypto index fund builder that creates custom index funds based on user conversations.
description: Brent is an innovative, AI-powered multi-asset token purchaser designed to streamline and optimize digital asset transactions across multiple blockchain networks. By integrating advanced agents and leveraging real-time analytics, Brent automates token acquisition from leading decentralized exchanges like Uniswap, ensuring seamless execution across diverse chains such as Polygon and Base. This intelligent solution consolidates multiple token purchases into a single efficient transaction, drastically reducing operational overhead and latency. Brent’s robust risk assessment algorithms evaluate market liquidity and volatility, mitigating potential vulnerabilities and ensuring cost-effective execution. The platform’s sophisticated API integrations and cross-chain compatibility deliver a dynamic, user-friendly experience tailored for both novice and experienced investors. With Brent, businesses can confidently navigate the complexities of decentralized finance by harnessing state-of-the-art technology that prioritizes efficiency, reliability, and informed decision-making in the rapidly evolving digital asset landscape. Our platform empowers investors with strategic insights and agility, driving competitive advantage in decentralized finance globally scalable.
how_its_made:
Brent is an AI-powered multi-asset token purchaser that automates the execution of multiple token transactions in one go. It taps into decentralized finance protocols by integrating with Uniswap’s API to search for token pairs and validate liquidity before bundling purchases into a single transaction. The backend, built on Next.js, leverages libraries such as viem for blockchain interactions—for example, in getERC20BalanceTool—to read contracts and verify token balances on networks like Polygon.

On the frontend, React.js is used to create a streamlined user interface, including chat client elements that help users interact with Brent. Zod is utilized for schema validation within our tool-creation framework (powered by the Covalent AI Agent SDK) to ensure robust input handling. Additionally, our service layer includes custom token filtering and transaction preparation logic, as detailed in PLAN.md, ensuring efficient and reliable performance across chain
